_readme: EXEMPTIONS from tooling/ci/assert-credential-origin.mjs, which READS this file. One row per (path, limb): limb P = the file reads a credential and sends without calling credentialOrigin(); limb R = a base-URL variable is read and not visibly pinned in that file.

A row is a REASON, checked by a person at review: the guard cannot see it. A row that suppresses nothing any more is a finding (STALE), so a row dies with its reason. Add one only when the credential still reaches its issuer alone by a path the guard's one-binding rule cannot follow, or when the credential is public by design.

exempt.reason: BASE is api()'s default `base` parameter, and api() pins it with credentialOrigin(base, 'glitchtip') on its first line, before any fetch. Its one other use is a dry-run log line in ensure-monitors.mjs, which sends nothing.

The service-role key goes only to mintMagicLinkTokenHash() in tooling/e2e/magic_link.mjs, which pins SUPABASE_URL before its one request; the key is deleted from process.env at read, so no child inherits it. The anon key is public by design: it ships in every web build.

process.env.SUPABASE_URL is passed as `url` to mintMagicLinkTokenHash() (tooling/e2e/magic_link.mjs), which pins it with credentialOrigin(url, 'supabase') before the request; the binding is a call argument the one-binding rule cannot follow.

It sends no request itself: its spawns are git, gh, flutter and node children. The vault's Supabase values are handed to provision_user.mjs and capture-play-screenshots.mjs, and each pins SUPABASE_URL before its own first request.

vault.get('SUPABASE_URL') is copied into the child environment only; the children pin it (provision_user.mjs directly, capture-play-screenshots.mjs through magic_link.mjs) before any request carries the key.

The one Supabase credential it reads is SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, the public anon key every web build ships. Its target is an operator's --target for a box that is not live yet, which the issuer pin would refuse by design.
SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_URL is the default for --target, a box the preflight exists to check before it becomes the issuer; only the public anon key goes there.
The one credential it reads is SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, the public anon key every web build ships, sent to auth/v1/settings on the box it verifies; no admin key is read.
SELFHOSTED_SUPABASE_URL (default BOXC_DEFAULT_TARGET) receives only the public anon key; the settings read is the verification of that box.
